summary.en-US: Click any picture to open it fullscreen with cursor zoom, pan and rotate. Unblocks right click and sees through image shields.

version.approval_notes: No build step: the submitted files are the source, as in https://github.com/Spillebulle/Pictureframe. The innerHTML assignments in content/viewer.js and content/reporter.js write static markup, numbers, or text passed through escapeHtml().
